title: Can You See Waterfalls From the Sea in Madeira?
description: A few. Véu da Noiva falls towards the sea on the north coast, and after rain thin falls streak the south-west cliffs. In a dry summer you see none at all.
heroAlt: The Véu da Noiva waterfall falling down a green cliff towards the sea on Madeira's north coast
keywords: can you see waterfalls from the sea in Madeira

images.prompt: Realistic photograph taken from the sea a few hundred metres off Madeira's north coast between São Vicente and Seixal, on a bright winter morning after rain. A tall, steep cliff covered in green vegetation rises from a dark rocky shore with white surf, and down its face a long thin white waterfall drops in a veil of spray towards the sea. Wisps of cloud cling to the higher slopes, deep blue Atlantic in the foreground with a gentle swell. No boats, no people, true colours, no text.
images.alt: The Véu da Noiva waterfall falling down a green cliff towards the sea on Madeira's north coast

images.prompt: Seen from a boat off Madeira's south coast near Cabo Girão on a clearing winter morning: several thin temporary white waterfalls streak down a dark brown cliff face, wet rock shining, grey clouds breaking to blue sky, calm sea below, realistic photo, no people, no text.
images.alt: Thin waterfalls streaking down a dark sea cliff on Madeira's south coast after rain
